entries.mem0ai/mem0: This official Hermes Agent memory provider offers a universal memory layer supporting multi-level states for Users, Sessions, and Agents. It features temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval, available as an OSS SDK, self-hosted server, or managed cloud.

entries.volcengine/OpenViking: This official Hermes Agent memory provider uses the viking:// protocol for deterministic context browsing and tiered L0/L1/L2 data loading. It is an AGPL-3.0 open-source context database that provides observable retrieval via directory-browsing trajectories.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: This brain for Hermes Agents provides synthesized answers featuring citations and gap analysis. It supports multi-user scoping for team institutional memory and creates typed edges without requiring LLM calls.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: This memory system facilitates long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows for agents. It provides Python and Node.js client SDKs and acts as an LLM wrapper for existing agents.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: A memory library for building stateful agents that supports peer-centric modeling and background reasoning. It is available as a managed service or a self-hosted FastAPI server with Python and TypeScript SDKs.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that manages a markdown context tree using git-like version control. It features a 5-tier retrieval system with sub-100ms latency and an interactive TUI/REPL interface.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: A zero-dependency memory system for Hermes Agents that utilizes a single SQLite database. It supports MCP via stdio or SSE and includes a Python SDK for direct memory operations.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: This seven-layer memory system includes vector search, structured facts, and an auto-curated wiki. It utilizes a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize injected context using local infrastructure like Qdrant and Redis.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: A recursive self-improving context harness that provides filesystem-first traces, reports, and datasets. It supports multiple agent providers, including Pi and MCP clients, and includes CLI tools for task investigation.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: A lossless context management plugin that uses a SQLite-backed message store and a depth-aware summary DAG. It prevents message loss and provides agent tools for searching and expanding compacted history.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: A self-hosted backend for Honcho that enables private cross-session memory for Hermes Agent. It supports local inference servers or any OpenAI-compatible LLM provider and includes an automated setup script for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis.
entries.plur-ai/plur: This shared memory layer uses an open engram YAML format to store memory as plain-text. It provides local-first, zero-cost search and supports Hermes alongside other agentic tools.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: This layer provides local custody of SQLite and workspace files to manage identity, memory, and secrets. It offers portable state across Hermes Agent and various MCP clients, reporting 97.6% LongMemEval answer accuracy.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: This on-device context engine uses hybrid retrieval, including BM25, vector search, and graph traversal, without cloud dependencies. It automates decision capture through a local GGUF observer model.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: This tool optimizes context through block reordering and deduplication to enable prefix reuse. It reduces prefill latency by 1.5–3× and features native plugin support for the Hermes Agent ecosystem.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: This file-based, local-first architecture uses SQLite with FTS5 search instead of vector databases or embeddings. It is distributed via a five-package plugin family including a Hermes adapter.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This self-maintaining plugin provides explainable recall by attaching a why_retrieved tag to every result. It manages temporal context graphs with recency-aware ranking and lifecycle management.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: This anticipatory memory system uses RAG and vector search to prefetch context by monitoring agent session logs. It utilizes SQLite-vec and GGUF models via node-llama-cpp.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: This memory kernel stack integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single owner. It manages state and retrieval using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to provide evidence packets per query.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: This reflective memory system uses semantic search with BM25 and ranked graph traversal. It automates indexing for codebases, URLs, and multimedia while using edge tags to create bidirectional relationships.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: This tool reduces prompt token overhead through local BM25 tool ranking and keyword selection. It is compatible with Hermes Agent v0.14.0 and includes a dashboard for tracking token savings.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: This layer resolves live workspace state into verified facts to reduce prompt tokens by 94%. It renders workspace facts into files like AGENTS.md and supports MCP via stdio or SSE.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: This daemonless memory solution stores information as inspectable Markdown files to ensure user ownership. It uses DuckDB as a replaceable retrieval cache for long-term, cross-project memory.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin utilizes a single.lbdb embedded graph database to manage memories. It features BM25-first retrieval and an importance ranking system from 1-10 to prioritize high-priority memories during context prefetch.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This pull-model episodic memory plugin supports immediate event deletion and provides a trace.jsonl audit log for every memory operation. It utilizes an on-demand summarizer to manage memory state.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: This provider offers durable cross-session memory through session-end snapshots and pre-turn context injection. It includes a local SQLite reliability layer and a write outbox alongside tools for searching and updating state.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server enables API charging for AI agents using USDC and stablecoins across multiple chain families, including EVM and Solana. It integrates with Hermes and other agent frameworks to facilitate payments.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: This plugin integrates Exabase M-1 to provide self-organizing long-term agent memory. It includes tools for manual memory storage and searching, with support for configurable query expansion and result reranking.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This AI-native memory solution provides AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and supports both embedded and multi-mode execution via Rust FFI or HTTP daemon. It utilizes HNSW, sparse, FM-index, and bitmap indexing for recall.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin provides local capability indexing and routing through five native tools for searching, fetching, and reporting on artifacts. It supports indexing for scripts, markdown documents, cron jobs, MCP servers, and skills.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider offers 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal using hybrid search methods. It combines BM25, vector, and graph methods with automatic context checkpointing during message compression.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin provides private, local code memory for repositories via localhost. It enables semantic and literal code search alongside grounded Q&A that includes file-and-line citations.

entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first system that enables Hermes Agent to handle design and prototyping tasks via a dedicated CLI. It supports automated exports to HTML, PDF, PPTX, and MP4 formats while maintaining compatibility with various coding agents.

entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project enables Hermes Agent to generate custom analytical instructions and thinking prompts tailored to specific domains. It enhances output quality by reporting findings alongside a dedicated analysis of potential blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This toolkit provides type-safe support for modular packages containing instructions, resources, and scripts. It utilizes progressive disclosure and remote registries to maintain prompt efficiency while supporting programmatic skill management.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: These skills automate the transition from rough concepts to structured design and implementation documents. The workflow includes Lite and Full complexity modes and features a spec review gate with PASS/FAIL evaluation models.

This approach reduces token usage during LLM calls and features graceful degradation if specific embedding models are unavailable.

It tracks quality scores and token savings in a local SQLite database while preserving non-English prompts through language detection heuristics.

It employs a risk-tiered triage system to categorize modifications and detects language-specific anti-patterns such as N+1 queries.
